title: Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT
author: Lee Reilly
description: GitHub’s annual month-long game jam is back for its 14th year! This November, make a game inspired by the theme SHIFT. Change gears, swap perspectives, bend reality, or just press a certain key. The post Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Game Off , GitHub’s annual month-long game jam, returns for its 14th year this November. Thousands of developers have joined us over the years to make everything from polished platformers to wonderfully weird experiments.
takeaways: Of course, you could also build a game about shifting tectonic plates, shape-shifting aliens, shifting alliances, shifting sands, or a particularly ambitious stick shift.
Use whichever programming languages, game engines, frameworks, libraries, and tools make sense for your game.
Create a free GitHub account if you don’t already have one.
